summary_1line: During the Khandava forest fire, Mandapala’s fledgling birds debate escape, refuse the hole, send their mother away, and face the approaching flames with solemn reflections.

image_candidates.scene_text: Four featherless nestlings sit exposed in their nest as the red wall of the Khandava forest fire advances through the trees.
A hawk swoops through smoky air clutching a mouse in its talons while the anxious mother bird watches from a branch.
The small birds look toward the roaring fire as flames with many tongues curl through the forest toward their nest.
